{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing values in flipper_length_mm or body_mass_g
subset = df[['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g']].dropna()

# Compute Pearson correlation
correlation = subset['flipper_length_mm'].corr(subset['body_mass_g'])

# Print only the correlation value as a bare number
print(correlation)"}
